bio: Enjoy a traditional Afternoon Tea at ABode Chester. Take a break from exploring this historic city and indulge in a selection of delightful treats at this stylish venue.  Located on Grosvenor Road, only a 5 minute walk from the city centre - Brasserie ABode nestles on the fifth floor of our hotel, initially stepping into a relaxed and cosmopolitan bar lounge area. The spacious layout of the 5th floor flows elegantly into our timeless restaurant, complete with an outdoor balcony, where you can relax and have a drink if the weather’s kind. Guests can unwind in a relaxed, sophisticated environment while enjoying panoramic views towards England’s Oldest working Racecourse and the Welsh hills.  Their Afternoon Tea menu features a selection of quintessential items of the great British tradition such as dainty finger sandwiches and sumptuous scones. The menu features a selection of scones, clotted cream, strawberry jam, savouries, sandwiches & pastries, all served with a choice of hot drinks... or why not upgrade with a chilled glass of Laurent-Perrier for something that little bit extra special! The classic Afternoon Tea features plentiful portions, presenting an extensive selection of teas and coffees to go with it. Perfect to enjoy whatever the occasion.  Brasserie ABode is located in the heart of this quaint city, just a short walk away from Eastgate clock and Chester rail station.
